A straight chain of one-nested-table-per-cell tables renders as pipe tables, not a broken layout list

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><table><tr><td><table><tr><td>leaf</td></tr></table></td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
